rationale: AAX editor lifecycle and tracing-attribution work: the AAX adapter pins the authored design viewport, places its child NSView top-left and binds the editor to the audio-owner Processor; the widget bridge splits raf_flush into traced raf_callbacks/raf_microtasks and keeps the script trace seam outside the js_native wrapper. All changes are editor hosting and Perfetto instrumentation; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
